lesson: The system consistently attempted to fade momentum or catch reversals during high-velocity phases, resulting in 8 consecutive losses as it ignored the dominant trend. The reliance on RSI exhaustion signals proved fatal, as the market treated oversold/overbought conditions as continuation triggers rather than mean-reversion opportunities.
adjustment: Implement a strict trend-filter rule that forbids counter-trend entries unless a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Upthrust is validated on the 4H timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based mean reversion less on POLUSDT; prioritize SMC structural order flow.
